method_note: 2026 IEEE Aerospace Conference (47th, Big Sky, MT, 7-14 Mar 2026). Source: the official Schedule & Program PDF. Unique program numbers (format T.SSPP = track.session.paper) were extracted from the timetable and EPH list: 351 papers in 89 sessions with at least one scheduled paper. Added 12 scheduled panel sessions (13.09 and Track 14 panels 14.01-14.08 and 14.10-14.12; 14.09 was listed but not scheduled), for 101 sessions in total. Track 1 plenaries were excluded. A session counts once however many papers it has, so 1-paper and 13-paper sessions weigh the same; per-track paper counts are in 'tracks'. Each session was mapped to 1-2 keywords using its 2026 session title from the program's 'Tracks, Sessions, and Organizers' list. Caveats: flight-software sessions (Track 10) were mapped to avionics, and the taxonomy has no keyword for cybersecurity (4.14, 12.04) or space power (8.09, 14.12), so these went to avionics or space-systems. Paper counts come from text extraction of the PDF and may miss a few entries whose numbers were split across lines. Dropped (<0.02): ssa-debris=0.01, od-nav=0.015, spacecraft-gnc=0.015, rovers=0.005, space-robotics=0.015, perception=0.015, ai-ml=0.015, aerodynamics=0.005, flight-dynamics=0.01, launch=0.01, planetary-defense=0.01, trajectory=0.005, air-transport=0.005, hri=0.01, osam=0.005, mechanisms=0.005, structures=0.005, space-propulsion=0.01, automation=0.005; the kept raw session fractions summed to 0.827 and were renormalized to sum to 1 (raw counts are in each evidence string). deployable-structures: none found in the 2026 session titles of the Schedule & Program (no deployable/mechanism-specific session; 8.07 'Mechanical Systems, Design and Technologies' held 1 paper, a structural/thermal payload design). Individual deployable papers sit inside broader sessions (e.g. 5.0708 'Trussed Deployable Structures That Enable Rendezvous & Proximity Operations' in 5.07; 5.0601 low-cost boom systems for suborbital ionospheric science in 5.06), so under this file's session-title method no session was reassigned.
